title: LLM-Generated Counterfactual Stress Scenarios for Portfolio Risk Simulation via Hybrid Prompt-RAG Pipeline
abstract: arXiv:2512.07867v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We develop a transparent, auditable large language model (LLM) pipeline for macro-financial stress testing. Structured prompting, with optional retrieval of country fundamentals and news, emits G7 macroeconomic scenarios (GDP growth, inflation, policy rate), which are converted into deviations from an IMF World Economic Outlook baseline and translated into portfolio losses through a three-channel PCA factor model. The macro-to-factor mapping is stipulated rather than estimated, so every tail-risk multiple is conditional on stated assumptions. Across 2,420 accepted scenarios from two model families and three runs, plus an unanchored-severity run and eight risk-layer ablations, we find three things. First, severity is inherited from scenario design, not generated by the model: prompt variant dominates every variance decomposition, removing the prompted severity bands makes GPT-5.6-luna's recession 1.6 pp milder, apparent country

translated_title: 基于混合提示-RAG流水线的LLM生成反事实压力情景用于投资组合风险模拟
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个透明、可审计的大语言模型（LLM）流水线，用于宏观金融压力测试。结构化提示（结合可选的国家基本面与新闻检索）生成七国集团（G7）宏观经济情景（GDP增长、通胀、政策利率），这些情景被转换为相对于IMF《世界经济展望》基线的偏差，并通过三通道PCA因子模型转化为投资组合损失。宏观到因子的映射是规定性而非估计性的，因此每个尾部风险倍数都以明确陈述的假设为条件。在来自两个模型家族、三次运行的2,420个已接受情景中，加上一次无锚定严重性运行和八次风险层消融实验，我们发现了三点。第一，严重性继承自情景设计，而非由模型生成：提示变体在所有方差分解中占主导地位，移除提示的严重性区间会使GPT-5.6-luna的衰退情景减轻1.6个百分点……
tldr: 该论文开发了一个透明、可审计的LLM混合提示-RAG流水线，用于生成反事实宏观金融压力测试情景并将其转化为投资组合损失，发现情景严重性主要继承自提示设计而非模型自发产生。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a transparent, auditable LLM hybrid prompt-RAG pipeline that generates counterfactual macro-financial stress scenarios and translates them into portfolio losses, finding that scenario severity is inherited from prompt design rather than generated by the model itself.
